Re-ran build_scene.py, regenerating scene.blend, scene.glb and poster.png. Rendered all four split states from the rebuilt blend at 840x600 (2x of a 420px panel) to captures/opus-pass/ as author evidence; those renders are not runtime captures.
analysis: Independent assessment: accept. The footprint encodes request count across two orthogonal horizontal axes (version, operation), height encodes rate, and amber volume equals the fixed 40 failures. Each split axis is a physical seam the reader can open independently, so the reader can choose either single split (4%, a visibly thin band) and the intersection (40%, a block), while the recommended video jumps from pooled to version-filtered exports. The relationship is carried by geometry (volume conserved while the footprint shrinks), and the labels only clarify it. GPT-6 fixes for the four Astra findings were checked in source and with verify.mjs and hold: exact footprints, removed combs, rate-representation captions, and tween replacement.

addressedFindings.issue: The geometry redistributes amber into healthy subgroups when joined, but captions describe failures as physically spread across v2. This can imply changing which requests failed.
addressedFindings.response: describe() and captions present amber as an aggregate rate of fixed failures; FAILED counts are unchanged in every state.

addressedFindings.issue: Decorative combs and unlabeled gauges consume the front edges while the causal scale and 100-request cell meaning are absent from the visible explanation.
addressedFindings.response: Combs remain removed. The gauge now sits flush beside the stationary v2 export amber face, which removes the parallax misreading GPT-6's placement introduced.

addressedFindings.issue: The claimed conserved amber volume is only approximate in the authored geometry.
addressedFindings.response: Amber footprints are exact; verify.mjs measures 0.15 transformed GLB volume within 1e-6 in all four states after rebuild.

addressedFindings.issue: Repeated control input can leave concurrent tweens writing the same positions and heights.
addressedFindings.response: apply() clears queued tweens and starts from the interpolated pose; verify.mjs exercises interrupted input, both orders and reset mid-tween.
